title: Okayama Castle — official history

facts.fact: Operator associates the original tower completion with1597, under Ukita Hideie; present building is not described as an intact16th-century original.
Tower burned during World WarII and was reconstructed in1966.
Black clapboard exterior explains the Ujo/Crow Castle name; river channels helped shape the castle town.
Castle history places the site beside the Asahi River.
